eval.question: List the available FOIA/declassified-document sources and choose where to start a search for CIA Reading Room material about weather modification.
eval.expected: Call list_sources first; identify cia as enabled and note that other sources are known but not fully wired before choosing search_source with source "cia".

eval.question: Find CIA Reading Room records about weather modification, then fetch the most relevant document metadata.
eval.expected: Call search_source with source "cia" and query "weather modification"; choose a returned record id or document URL; call get_source_record with source "cia"; report title, URL/PDF, citation note, terms note, and warnings if present.

eval.question: Continue a CIA Reading Room search after the first page.
eval.expected: Call search_source with source "cia"; if next_cursor is present, pass that cursor to a second search_source call with the same query and source; explain when no cursor is available.

eval.question: Get details for CIA document cia-rdp68r00530a000200110020-2.
eval.expected: Call get_source_record with source "cia" and id_or_url "cia-rdp68r00530a000200110020-2"; report normalized metadata, source URLs, PDF URL when available, and citation/terms notes.

eval.question: Search for HAARP ionospheric heating documents. If CIA has no useful result, recover by choosing another official source.
eval.expected: Call list_sources, then search_source with source "cia"; if results are empty or off-topic, explain which adapters are enabled, distinguish configured adapters from future source guidance, and recommend the most relevant official source entry points rather than inventing results.

eval.question: Start ingesting a CIA document, then check whether the ingestion job was persisted.
eval.expected: Call ingest_document with a source-prefixed document_id such as "cia:CREST-test"; capture the returned job id, status, progress, document_id, and next_actions; call get_ingestion_job with that id and confirm the durable queued status and next action.

eval.question: A user asks to ingest "CREST-test" without a source prefix. Recover from the error and submit the corrected job.
eval.expected: Call ingest_document with the provided id; recognize the invalid_params error requiring "<source>:<source_id>"; retry with a valid source-prefixed id such as "cia:CREST-test"; report the queued job.

eval.question: Search locally ingested documents for "weather modification" and narrow to CIA records.
eval.expected: Call search_local_documents with query "weather modification", source "cia", and an appropriate limit; return traceable document_key/chunk/page hits when present, or explain that the local index may be empty until ingestion workers populate it.

eval.question: A local search was requested with source "state-dept". Recover without losing the research task.
eval.expected: Call search_local_documents with the requested source; recognize the invalid source error; list valid sources or call list_sources; retry with a valid source if the user intent maps cleanly, otherwise ask for a valid source.

eval.question: Retrieve metadata and page text for locally ingested document cia:CREST-weather, pages 2 through 4.
eval.expected: Call get_document with document_id "cia:CREST-weather"; call get_document_text with page_start 2 and page_end 4; report public_id, title, page citations, text_source values, and extracted text snippets.

eval.question: A user asks for all text from a document without page bounds. Recover with a bounded request.
eval.expected: Call get_document_text without page_start/page_end only if necessary to discover the error; recognize that explicit one-based bounds are required and at most 50 pages are allowed; retry or ask for a bounded page range.

eval.question: A user asks for pages 20 through 5 from a local document. Recover from the page-range error.
eval.expected: Call get_document_text with the provided range; recognize the invalid_params error that page_start must be less than or equal to page_end; retry with corrected bounds if the intended range is clear.

eval.question: Refresh a locally ingested CIA document and check the resulting job.
eval.expected: Call refresh_document with document_id "cia:CREST-weather"; capture the returned refresh job id; call get_ingestion_job with that id; report queued/resumable status and pending worker next actions.

eval.question: Build a citation trail for weather modification military history using only official repositories.
eval.expected: Call list_sources; use search_source/get_source_record for CIA leads; use search_local_documents/get_document/get_document_text for already ingested material; clearly distinguish implemented CIA/local flows from source suggestions that are not yet directly searchable.

eval.question: A NARA search cannot run because no API key is configured. Explain what happened and keep the user moving.
eval.expected: Call search_source with source "nara"; recognize the structured configuration error; use list_sources to provide current source status and explain that FOIA_SEARCH_NARA_API_KEY is required while still suggesting CIA/local search or official NARA manual search as fallback paths.

eval.question: Compare best official sources for ENMOD treaty text versus Project Stormfury technical reports.
eval.expected: Call list_sources; map ENMOD to legal/government publication sources and Stormfury to NOAA/NARA/DTIC-style repositories while stating which are currently direct MCP adapters and which are source-status guidance.

eval.question: Find a PURSUE/war.gov UAP release-tranche record and retrieve normalized official metadata for one returned item.
eval.expected: Call list_sources, then search_source with source "pursue" and a release-focused query; pick a returned pursue record id or official URL and call get_source_record; report citation note, terms note, release-tranche metadata, and that image/video assets are metadata-only while PDFs are ingest-preferred.

eval.question: Find a DOJ Epstein disclosure lead, retrieve its record details, and report sensitivity plus provenance context.
eval.expected: Call list_sources, then search_source with source "doj_epstein" using terms like "data set", "court records", or "foia"; call get_source_record for one returned lead id/URL; report DOJ sensitivity/privacy warning, citation/terms notes, category provenance (e.g., efta_data_set/court_record/foia/prior_doj_disclosure), and that PDFs are ingest-preferred while image/audio/video remain metadata assets.
